crossRefs.note: Abner said to him, “Turn away to your right hand or to your left, and grab one of the young men, and take his armor.”…
Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant…
“Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you not turn…
He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and walked in all the way of David his father, and didn’t turn away to…
Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.

people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: Asahel
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, killed by Abner

translations.web: Asahel pursued Abner; and in going he didn’t turn to the right hand or to the left from following Abner.
translations.bsb: and he chased Abner, not turning to the right or to the left in his pursuit.
translations.kjv: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.
translations.asv: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.
